versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the GitHub Projects v2 skill.
- Enables listing and filtering project backlog items using the `gh project` CLI.
- Supports setting project fields such as status, iteration, priority, and more.
- Provides commands for adding comments to issues and creating new issues with project assignment.
- Includes instructions for managing sub-issues via the `gh-sub-issue` extension or GraphQL fallback.
- Requires users to authenticate with the `project` scope for full functionality.
